name: FirmsModisFireDetection
description: One active-fire pixel detection from a NASA FIRMS MODIS product, transcribed from the NASA.FIRMS.FireDetection event of the real-time-sources feeder for the case where the acquiring instrument is MODIS. The sample exists because the two temperatures the record carries are not one number twice: `brightness` is the pixel radiance expressed as a temperature in MODIS channel 21/22, near four micrometres, and `bright_t31` is the same in channel 31, near eleven micrometres, and the fire-detection algorithm works precisely by comparing the two bands. A bare pair of Kelvin values says neither which wavelength each was measured in nor that they are brightness temperatures rather than surface temperatures. It demonstrates `spectralBands` binding the two band values to the sensor's thermal-anomaly band set in the order that set declares them, with the specific two-band subset named by a fragment on the sensor's band specification, as the specification's own Landsat example names a sensor by fragment; and it demonstrates `calibration` stating that the values are brightness temperatures, an open calibration value, since the enumeration names digital numbers, radiance, and reflectance but not the thermal case. The nine-band Operational Land Imager example in the specification shows the fuller multiband form; this is the minimal real-feed case.

source.description: FIRMS product source identifier for the satellite and sensor, from the `source` field, such as `MODIS_NRT`. It identifies the product the detection came from.

latitude.description: Latitude of the centre of the nominal one-kilometre fire pixel in WGS-84 decimal degrees, from the `latitude` field.

longitude.description: Longitude of the pixel centre in WGS-84 decimal degrees, from the `longitude` field.

brightness.description: Brightness temperature of the fire pixel in MODIS channel 21/22, near four micrometres, from the `brightness` field. It is the first band of the pair the fire product resolves.

bright_t31.description: Brightness temperature of the fire pixel in MODIS channel 31, near eleven micrometres, from the `bright_t31` field. Paired with `brightness` to screen false alarms and gauge fire intensity.

frp.description: Fire radiative power in megawatts, from the `frp` field: the radiative energy release rate within the pixel.

acq_datetime.description: UTC acquisition instant of the overpass, from the `acq_datetime` field, in ISO-8601 form.

satellite.description: Short platform code of the acquiring satellite, from the `satellite` field, such as `T` for Terra or `A` for Aqua.
